testPolicy.text: FSU is subject to Florida Board of Governors admissions regulation 6.002, which requires first-year applicants to submit an ACT, CLT or SAT score. At least one score must be submitted before the materials deadline; FSU does not accept self-reported scores from the Common App (scores are self-reported on the FSU Admissions Portal).

facts.text: For fall 2025 FSU admitted 15,196 of 44,631 Florida applicants but only 4,671 of 34,530 out-of-state applicants and 497 of 6,308 international applicants.
Early Action is reserved for Florida residents; out-of-state domestic students who want an early answer must use binding Early Decision (both due October 15).
Regular Decision closes December 1, earlier than at most universities, with a rolling deadline of March 1 after that.
A test score (ACT, CLT or SAT) is mandatory under Florida Board of Governors rules, and Common App self-reported scores are not accepted.
The 2026-27 on-campus budget is 26,018 for a Florida resident and 43,916 for a non-resident.
Only 5 students were admitted from the fall 2025 waiting list, out of 2,358 who accepted a place.

notes: Cycle from FSU CDS 2025-26 C1 (34,886 + 50,537 + 46 = 85,469 applied; 9,028 + 11,335 + 1 = 20,364 admitted; 2,716 + 3,843 = 6,559 enrolled, of which 134 part-time). The CDS is an ASP.NET page (select 2025-26 and section C or G, then View); no stable per-section URL exists, so the page URL is cited. C21/C22 dates in the CDS are for the 2026-27 cycle (10/15/2026, notification 12/17/2026); fall 2025 ED counts are blank. Cost from the tuition office page (13 credits per term) differs from CDS G1 (30 credits, tuition 4,640 / 23,825 plus fees 1,877). FSU proposes market-rate fee increases effective fall 2027 (tuition.fsu.edu notice). No official aid promise page checked, so aidPromise is null.
